verdict.rationale: CockroachDB ships two documented first-party CLIs. The `cockroach` binary, installable via Homebrew, offers commands such as `cockroach demo` that open an interactive SQL shell. The `ccloud` CLI creates, manages, and connects to CockroachDB Cloud clusters, including an interactive `ccloud quickstart`. missing for 10: evidence of agent-oriented CLI features (machine-readable/JSON output, non-interactive scripted auth), independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use in AI workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The `ccloud` tool is a command-line interface (CLI) tool that allows you to create, manage, and connect to CockroachDB Cloud clusters.
install `ccloud` and use the `ccloud quickstart` command to interactively log in and create a new CockroachDB Serverless cluster.
The `cockroach demo` starts a temporary, in-memory CockroachDB cluster of one or more nodes, with or without a preloaded dataset, and opens an interactive SQL shell to the cluster.
